review.imagery: Root reviewed all 32 complete original brochure pages, all twenty-one extracted native resources and fourteen current website candidates. Twenty-one selected renders retain specific home or planned shared-community scope. All residential interior resources, including two images on each of brochure pages 17 and 18, remain separately attributed. Wider beach and master-community scenes are explicitly labelled. Icons, developer logo and repeated website compositions were excluded. The original source is concept material and does not establish completed photography or final finishes.
review.floorPlans: Root read all thirteen complete delivered sheets and every whole-home area panel. Brochure page 20 gives 127 + 121 = 248 m², page 23 gives 131 + 124 = 255 m² and page 26 gives 137 + 122 + 82 = 341 m². All corresponding complete ground/first/second-floor plans retain room tables and notices. Page 29 is labelled SF Baseline with flexible bedroom/family room, while page 30 is SF Premium Option with gym, plunge, sauna and changing room. No premium facility or fifth bedroom was generalized across both options. The premium option has no independently verified contracted area. Whole-home totals are not multiplied across levels. Complete original PDF and physical-page source links are preserved.
review.location: Root read the complete current official JPEG, original regional sheet 5 and master sheet 6. Five destination estimates agree across the regional sources. The master plan separately names nearby retail, medical, beach/hotel and future development context without proving current access or completion. The generic Hudayriyat sales centre remains separate from a final home entrance. No surveyed home pin, live route, journey mode or kilometre distance was invented.
review.provenance: Normal-GET receipts preserve source HTML, current official map and website resources, complete original brochure, dates, bytes and SHA256. Selected native image resources retain original bytes and physical page attribution. Poppler complete source renders retain the original notices, room lists and area panels with lossless delivery. Previously researched commercial data, original source qualifications and all protected identities remain unchanged.
